bankName.description: Name of the bank (required for the add-bank-details path).

bankCountry.description:
Country of the bank — ISO 2/3 letter code or country name (required for the
add-bank-details path). Resolved to a country name for the Dropbox `bankAddress`
merge field via the same lookup as `BankDetailsResolver`.

accountHolderName.description: Name of the account holder (required for the add-bank-details path).

accountNumber.description: Account number (required for the add-bank-details path).

abaNumber.description: ABA / routing number (optional). Skipped in Dropbox merge when blank.

iban.description:
IBAN (optional). Accepted for audit storage only — there is no Dropbox IBAN merge
field in the current bank-details profile.

bic.description: Legacy BIC field retained for backward compatibility with older clients.

BankAccountDetailsRequest.description:
Bank account details sent as a structured object by the frontend when the fund requires USD settlement via bank wire (not applicable for Diamond BTC Fund).
When `SourceOfFunds = Bank` and the template declares `BankId`, the frontend may either send an existing Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.SubscriptionDetailsRequest.BankId (saved account) OR omit BankId and supply the add-bank-details fields below. Required for the inline path: Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.BankAccountDetailsRequest.BankName, Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.BankAccountDetailsRequest.BankCountry, Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.BankAccountDetailsRequest.AccountHolderName, Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.BankAccountDetailsRequest.AccountNumber. Optional: Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.BankAccountDetailsRequest.AbaNumber, Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.BankAccountDetailsRequest.Iban. Inline details are not persisted as a `CustomerBankAccount` — they are injected into Dropbox merge fields only.

sidePreference.description:
If AmountFrom and AmountTo are both specified,
SidePreference will be used to determine whether
the fixed amount is on the buy (To) side or the sell (From) side.

totalSubscribedUsd.description:
Sum of SubscriptionAmount for Open subscriptions only.
Closed subscriptions are returned but contribute zero to this total.

subscriptions.description: Open subscriptions first, Closed at the bottom.

PrimaryContactRequest.description:
Primary contact details (name + address lines) sent as a nested object by the frontend.
Maps to `primaryContactAddressLine1/2` Dropbox merge fields.

ResidentialAddressRequest.description:
Residential address sent as a nested object by the frontend.
Maps to the `residentialaddress*` Dropbox merge fields.

sidePreference.description:
If AmountFrom and AmountTo are both specified,
SidePreference will be used to determine whether
the fixed amount is on the buy (To) side or the sell (From) side.

subscriptionAmount.description:
Raw subscription amount in the asset's native denomination.
When Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.StructuredProductSubscriptionRow.SubscriptionAsset is null this is already USD.
Use Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.StructuredProductSubscriptionRow.SubscriptionAmountUsd for the always-USD value.

subscriptionAmountUsd.description:
Subscription amount converted to USD.
Equals Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.StructuredProductSubscriptionRow.SubscriptionAmount when Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.StructuredProductSubscriptionRow.SubscriptionAsset is null.
When a payment asset is present this is the FX-converted USD value.

subscriptionAsset.description: Optional payment asset (e.g. USDT / USDC). Null when not recorded.

status.description: Open / Closed lifecycle status of the subscription.

hasSubscriptionAgreementUrl.description: True when a signed subscription agreement PDF has been uploaded.

theme.description: Market theme / directional bias of the product.

hasTermSheetUrl.description: True when a termsheet PDF has been uploaded for the product.

StructuredProductSubscriptionRow.description:
A single row in the investor's structured product subscriptions list.
Combines subscription-level fields with product-level fields read from the
linked StructuredProduct.

status.description:
Derived status string for backwards compatibility:
"ManualFlow" | "ContractSent" | "Submitted" | "ValidationFailed" | error-code string.
Prefer Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.SubmitSubscriptionResponse.IsAccepted, Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.SubmitSubscriptionResponse.HasValidationErrors, and
Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.SubmitSubscriptionResponse.RequiresManualFlow for new consumers.

isAccepted.description: true when the submission was accepted and session transitioned to Submitted.

hasValidationErrors.description: true when required fields are still missing — re-render the form using Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.SubmitSubscriptionResponse.StillMissingFields.

stillMissingFields.description: Logical field names that are still missing, e.g. ["SubscriptionAmount"].

errorCode.description: Set for session-level errors (not found, expired, wrong status, missing template).

requiresManualFlow.description:
`true` when a pre-submit wallet validation check routed the request to the manual
            flow (e.g. XBTO wallet not found, Crypto wallet details incomplete, Self address missing).
            When `true`, the UI should redirect the investor to the manual subscription flow.

manualFlowReasonCode.description:
The reason code string explaining why manual flow was triggered.
Populated only when Stablehouse.Web.Controllers.SubmitSubscriptionResponse.RequiresManualFlow is `true`.
Possible values: "ProTradingAccountNotFound" | "WalletAddressNotFound" | "WalletDetailsIncomplete" | "WalletAddressMissing" | "ProTradingResolutionFailed" | "BankDetailsResolutionFailed".

SubscriptionAssetIdentityDto.description:
Lightweight identity of the optional payment asset recorded on a subscription
(e.g. USDT / USDC). Null when no payment asset was recorded.

bankAccountDetails.description:
Bank account details — sent as a structured object by the frontend.
Not applicable for Diamond BTC Fund (null in that case).

bankName.description: Bank name — flat field, separate from BankAccountDetails.

electronicNoticesConsent.description:
Option-group value: "Yes" or "No".
The frontend may send a JSON string "Yes"/"No" OR a JSON boolean true/false.
Both are accepted — booleans are coerced to "Yes"/"No" in ToFormData().
Expanded by the merger into two Dropbox checkboxes (electronicNoticesConsentYes/No).

isWalletDigitalAssetExchange.description:
Option-group value: "Yes" or "No".
The frontend may send a JSON string "Yes"/"No" OR a JSON boolean true/false.
Both are accepted — booleans are coerced to "Yes"/"No" in ToFormData().
Expanded by the merger into two Dropbox checkboxes (isWalletDigitalAssetExchangeYes/No).

isCustomerOfExchange.description:
Option-group value: "Yes" or "No".
The frontend may send a JSON string "Yes"/"No" OR a JSON boolean true/false.
Both are accepted — booleans are coerced to "Yes"/"No" in ToFormData().
Expanded by the merger into two Dropbox checkboxes (isCustomerOfExchangeYes/No).

primaryContact.description: Primary contact name + address lines. Maps to Sumsub-sourced fields with form fallback.

residentialAddress.description: Residential address sent as a nested object. Maps to residentialaddress* Dropbox merge fields.

canTrade.description: If false, this trade could not be executed, either due to insufficient user balance or insufficient liquidity.

maxAmountTo.description: Specified if CanTrade is false due to insufficient liquidity.

maxAmountFrom.description: Specified if CanTrade is false due to insufficient user balance.

amount.description: Amount that will be taken from the user's balance.
